exposure: Age (older primiparae ≥35 years old vs. younger primiparae 20-34 years old)
Communication with partner about parenting role
finding: Factors associated with maternal confidence at 1 month postpartum differed between older and younger primiparous mothers, with emotional support being key for older mothers and appraisal support and exclusive breastfeeding for younger mothers.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was controlled for in the analysis.
